<?php
require 'tests/mohe-ai/state-store-contract.php';
require_once '后端代码/app/services/ai/execution/AiRunExecutionRuntime.php';
use app\services\ai\execution\AiRunStore;
use app\services\ai\execution\AiRunExecutionRuntime;
$base=$checks;$saved=getenv('MOHE_AI_EXECUTION_WORKER_ID');$pid=getmypid();$host=(string)php_uname('n');
if(!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$/D',$host))$host='host-'.substr(hash('sha256',$host),0,32);
putenv('MOHE_AI_EXECUTION_WORKER_ID=ai-exec-'.$pid.'-'.str_repeat('a',24));$out=[];
try {
 foreach(['completed','partial','failed_known','failed_unknown'] as $case){
  $db=new PDO('sqlite::memory:');installAiStateFixture($db);$now=1000000;
  $store=new AiRunStore($db,'','opt3.worker.extra',static function()use(&$now):int{return $now;});
  $owner=['account_id'=>21,'terminal'=>'platform','conversation_id'=>'conversation','window_id'=>'window'];
  $run=$store->create($owner,'request',hash('sha256','query'),$snapshot,300000)['run'];$id=$run['run_id'];$g=$run['generation'];$token='old-worker-token';
  $ref='request-'.str_repeat('c',48);$store->queueExecution($owner,$id,$g,'execute',$ref,hash('sha256','input'));$store->queuedExecution($id);
  $store->startQueuedExecutionWorker($id,'ai-exec-'.$pid.'-'.str_repeat('b',24),$pid,$host);$store->claim($owner,$id,$g,$token);
  $store->reserve($owner,$id,$g,$token,'stage_count');$store->prepareAttempt($owner,$id,$g,$token,'model','model',hash('sha256','synthetic payload'),'siliconflow');$store->sendAttempt($owner,$id,$g,$token,'model');
  $unknown=$case==='failed_unknown';$store->finishAttempt($owner,$id,$g,$token,'model',$unknown?'UNKNOWN':'SUCCEEDED',$unknown?null:3,$unknown?null:2);
  if($case==='completed'||$case==='partial')$store->publish($owner,$id,$g,$token,'evidence','answer',$case==='partial'?'data_only_export_failed':'complete');
  else $store->fail($owner,$id,$g,$token,$unknown?'AI_MODEL_RESULT_UNKNOWN':'AI_EXECUTION_CHECK_FAILED');
  $before=$store->get($owner,$id,$g);$attemptBefore=$db->query('SELECT state,input_tokens,output_tokens FROM mohe_ai_attempt')->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);$now+=210001;
  checkState(AiRunExecutionRuntime::recoverStoppedWorkers($store)===1,$case.' reclaims proven dead consumer');$after=$store->get($owner,$id,$g);
  $attemptAfter=$db->query('SELECT state,input_tokens,output_tokens FROM mohe_ai_attempt')->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
  checkState($after['status']===$before['status']&&$after['reason']===$before['reason'],$case.' preserves exact terminal outcome');
  checkState($attemptAfter===$attemptBefore,$case.' preserves known/unknown receipt and exact usage');
  checkState($after['slot_held']===0&&$after['answer_ref']===$before['answer_ref']&&$after['evidence_ref']===$before['evidence_ref'],$case.' releases only physical reservation');
  checkState($store->queuedExecution($id)===null&&AiRunExecutionRuntime::recoverStoppedWorkers($store)===0,$case.' no replay and idempotent recovery');
  $out[]=['case'=>$case,'status'=>$after['status'],'reason'=>$after['reason'],'attempt'=>$attemptAfter,'slot_held'=>$after['slot_held']];
 }
}finally{putenv($saved===false?'MOHE_AI_EXECUTION_WORKER_ID':'MOHE_AI_EXECUTION_WORKER_ID='.$saved);}
echo 'EXTRA_WORKER_RESULT='.json_encode(['pass'=>true,'assertions'=>$checks-$base,'cases'=>$out]).PHP_EOL;
